scenarios.name: idempotent-job
scenarios.expected: First accepted 202, retry same identity 200, one job/frame; eventual result_id is preserved. Different body/key collision is 409. This is consistency of fixtures, NOT a server idempotency test.

scenarios.name: late-source
scenarios.expected: Schema-valid late result is historical only; UI current-source check must discard overlay. New submissions from old source rejected 409.

scenarios.name: duplicate-event
scenarios.expected: Same event_id and result_id; consumer dedup once. No exactly-once delivery claim.
